subject: techradar.com and AI search
body:
Hello,

I’ve been looking at which publishers AI search tools point UK shoppers to.

techradar.com was cited in 21 of the 80 consumer electronics answers in a dated sample of UK buyer queries.[^c1][^c2][^c3] It was cited in both runs of the sample, not just one.[^c4]

Would it be worth a short conversation about whether an observe-only feasibility check on a few pages is practical, and what your SEO and engineering leads would need to see before agreeing to one?

Best wishes
